climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: An Aragón DO on a plateau. It dates to 1932, among the oldest protected areas in Europe. Its allowed grapes include Garnacha Tinta, Mazuela, Tempranillo and Syrah.
